mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defense_audit_log (defense_id, user_id, topic_id, event, round_num, detail, created_at) VALUES (#{defenseId}, #{userId}, #{topicId}, #{event}, #{roundNum}, #{detail}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT log_id, defense_id, user_id, topic_id, event, round_num, detail, created_at FROM defense_audit_log WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId} ORDER BY log_id ASC
